name: El Bunkker
description: Uruguayan online store for outdoor, camping, tactical and sports gear, with tools, electronics and apparel. Prices are shown in USD and UYU; its FAQ states nationwide delivery, free above US$100 for non-bulky items.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de outdoor, camping, tactical y deportes, además de herramientas, electrónicos y vestimenta. Precios en USD y UYU; sus preguntas frecuentes indican envíos a todo el país, gratis sobre US$100 salvo artículos voluminosos.

ships_to.notes: Nationwide; free shipping on orders over US$100 except large-volume items; same-day express in Montevideo and nearby coast per FAQ

shopping_notes: WooCommerce store. Shipping method and cost are chosen in the cart. Some categories were moved to gostore.uy (a separate listed store). Shipping times are stated differently on the home page and FAQ.

sources.supports: home page: categories, USD and UYU prices, free shipping over US$100
FAQ: shipping costs, free threshold, express coverage, payment methods
